title: Fishhook
source_docs: Vehicle Dynamics Blockset/Vehicle Scenarios/Drive Cycle and Maneuvers/Fishhook.md
text: 生成用于执行鱼钩机动的命令，输入 2 路、输出 2 路；{Maneuver start time, tStart [s]} 指定开始时间、{Longitudinal velocity setpoint, velRef} 指定目标速度、{Longitudinal velocity setpoint units, velRefUnit []} 指定单位 mph、{Steer and countersteer speed, steerRate [deg/s]} 指定转向和反向转向速率、{Steer amplitude, steerAmp [deg]} 指定方向盘转向幅度、{Use roll rate to determine initial steer dwell time} 用于使用侧倾角速度确定初始转向停留时间、{Initial dwell time, tDwellSteer [s]} 指定初始停留时间、{Countersteer dwell time, tDwellCntrSteer [s]} 指定反向转向停留时间、{Return to center time, tZero [s]} 指定将反向转向幅度恢复到零转向所需的时间、{Roll rate countersteer initiation zero crossing threshold, pZero [deg/s]} 指定侧倾角速度容差、{Initial steer direction} 指定初始转向方向，按实例取值。

params.name: Steer and countersteer speed, steerRate [deg/s]
params.values: 转向和反向转向速率 720 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Steer amplitude, steerAmp [deg]
params.values: 方向盘转向幅度 540 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Use roll rate to determine initial steer dwell time
params.values: 用于使用侧倾角速度确定初始转向停留时间的选项 off (default) | on

params.name: Initial dwell time, tDwellSteer [s]
params.values: 初始停留时间 0.5 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Countersteer dwell time, tDwellCntrSteer [s]
params.values: 反向转向停留时间 3 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Return to center time, tZero [s]
params.values: 将反向转向幅度恢复到零转向所需的时间 2 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Roll rate countersteer initiation zero crossing threshold, pZero [deg/s]
params.values: 侧倾角速度容差 1.5 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Initial steer direction
params.values: 初始转向方向 Right (default) | Left
